name: Onboarding: an objective without a name is refused

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
Click 'CONFIRM OBJECTIVES' without typing a name in the new, empty objective
The error text 'Every task needs a name.' is shown and the '[ DAILY QUEST ]' setup window is still displayed (no '[ REST PERIOD ]' window)
